items.title: Stuart Bergen Interview, 1970-07-18
items.q: Yeah, my dad went in with Kittredge Waters. He was one of the founders.

ctx.x: Your daddy was there before you at Kittredge Waters?

Yeah, my dad went in with Kittredge Waters. He was one of the founders. He was that hyphen in the middle, you know, Kittredge-Waters. My daddy did pretty good. We lived in a poor neighborhood, but I was a little rich boy in a poor neighborhood. We had all the balls and the gloves and man, that house we lived in, I'd love to have it right here, on Sony Ant-Laurel. It's a three story house with marble fireplaces, about 12 foot ceilings, about 18 to 20 foot hall ceilings, mahogany stat rail. All the antiques my…
Give them to me, I'll take it.
